stale.offline: Offline. Showing what was known at {{time}}.
stale.cached: Showing saved data from {{time}}. It may be out of date.

container.restartDescription: The container stops and starts again. Open connections to it are dropped.
container.restartOffline: You are offline, so nothing can be restarted.
container.error: Docker reported an error for this container.

device.title: This device
device.pushIntro: Alerts and approval requests arrive on this device even when McHarbor is closed.
device.transit: Notifications travel through your browser vendor's push service (Google, Apple, Mozilla or Microsoft). The message is encrypted for this device and carries only the alert text and a link, but the push service does learn that a notification was sent.
device.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications.
device.insecure: Push notifications need a trusted HTTPS certificate. Open McHarbor on a publicly trusted certificate to use them.
device.iosInstall: On iPhone and iPad, add McHarbor to the Home Screen first (Share, then Add to Home Screen), and open it from there.
device.denied: Notifications are blocked for McHarbor in this browser's settings.
device.label: Device name
device.enabled: Push notifications are on for this device.
device.noDevices: No device receives push notifications yet.
device.revokeDescription: This device stops receiving push notifications. It can be turned on again from the device itself.
device.workerUnavailable: This browser did not start McHarbor's background worker, which push needs. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, the certificate is probably not trusted by this device.
